widgets_values: A dramatic silhouette portrait of an elegant neck in profile against a luminous, deep midnight-purple background. The jaw and throat are cast in plum-dark shadow, hair pinned high exposing the ear, while a teardrop ruby pendant earring hangs from the lobe, its crimson core lit from behind like an ember, scattering a faint red glow onto the shadowed skin below. The light passes through the blood-red stone itself, isolating its inner fire as the sole focal point of the high-contrast, minimalist composition. Absolutely no text, no typography, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no captions, pure imagery only.
